questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. A. Because the educational institution's teaching staff is actively involved. B. Curricular or academic activities refer to activities that cover the specified courses of study. C . These exercises are an essential component of the overall educational curriculum. D . In layman's terms, ‘curricular activities’ are activities that take place within the classroom.
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Because the educational institution's teaching staff is actively involved.

B. Curricular or academic activities refer to activities that cover the specified courses of study.

C. These exercises are an essential component of the overall educational curriculum.

D. In layman's terms, ‘curricular activities’ are activities that take place within the classroom.
questions.solution: B comes first because it introduces the main topic Curricular or academic activities, giving the definition and scope. It sets the context for what curricular activities are.

A. Redeeming B. Fairly C. Headache D. Uncertainty
questions.questionHtml:
In the passage below, four blanks are provided, marked as (A), (B), (C), and (D). Four words have been provided below the passage. Choose the correct arrangement of these words to fill in the blanks

The ______________ part, however, is that the overall food supply situation is _________________ comfortable compared to a year ago at the height of the Russia-Ukraine war, or even two months back, when there was a lot of ___________________ over India’s wheat crop and milk had turned the policymakers’ next big ____________________.

A. Redeeming

B. Fairly

C. Headache

options.html: a, c, b, d
a, b, d, c
c, d, a, b

questions.solution: Redeeming (A): The word "redeeming" means a positive or compensating quality in an otherwise negative situation. Here, it fits well as the "redeeming part" (i.e., the positive aspect) of the overall food supply situation is being highlighted.

questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. P) The serious complaint of human rights violation recently against an IPS officer in Ambasamudram in south Tamil Nadu should greatly embarrass the State government and the police hierarchy. Q) The officer has been suspended from service and his alleged misconduct is being probed. R) This should send a strong message to the police force in the State that no illegal physical treatment of crime suspects will be tolerated and that such behaviour will be subjected to a clinical and credible enquiry by an independent authority. S) The Chief Minister must be complimented for his swift action against the offending official.
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

P) The serious complaint of human rights violation recently against an IPS officer in Ambasamudram in south Tamil Nadu should greatly embarrass the State government and the police hierarchy.

Q) The officer has been suspended from service and his alleged misconduct is being probed.

R) This should send a strong message to the police force in the State that no illegal physical treatment of crime suspects will be tolerated and that such behaviour will be subjected to a clinical and credible enquiry by an independent authority.

S) The Chief Minister must be complimented for his swift action against the offending official.
questions.solution: P: This sentence introduces an incident of human rights violation against an IPS officer. It is an introductory sentence that sets the context for the rest of the paragraph. Hence, P should come first
